visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in pigtails, wearing a white ruffled midi dress and white sneakers, stands in a crowded outdoor market. She holds a small pink handbag and a clear bag with snacks. Rows of yellow lanterns hang from the eaves above the narrow street. She points toward the lanterns with a bright smile. (2) The scene shifts to the woman standing in front of a food stall. A large decorative bowl filled with purple and yellow sweet potato balls is on display. She holds a single sweet potato ball on a wooden stick near her open mouth, looking excited. Yellow and red signage with text is visible on the stall. (3) The woman is back in the center of the lantern-lined street. She poses with a peace sign, looking directly at the camera with a playful expression. Passers-by walk in the background, and the ground is dark asphalt. (4) The scene cuts to her standing before a different stall featuring stacks of green guava. She holds a piece of fruit on a stick and poses. The stall has a prominent green and yellow sign with stylized character drawings. (5) The final phase shows her at a roadside location near a tea shop called KEBUKE. She holds a large white paper cup with a straw, posing with a slight pout. In the background, there is a busy road intersection with green traffic signs and urban buildings.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog aimed at showcasing a visit to the Keelung Miaokou Night Market in Taiwan. By combining energetic K-Pop music with vibrant visuals of local food stalls and the iconic lantern-lit streets, it presents the market as an exciting and attractive destination for foodies and tourists.
